items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Leo Cornett, somebody named [Ira] Ferguson, Russell Hampton. Who was Ferguson? [INTERVIEWEE] I’m thinking that Ferguson was – Ferguson, Ferguson.

ctx.x: A trumpet player from Cincinnati, Ohio.
Leo Cornett, somebody named [Ira] Ferguson, Russell Hampton. Who was Ferguson?
I’m thinking that Ferguson was – Ferguson, Ferguson. They don’t have any other there for him.
